scripts.package:linux: npm run build:linux:binary && npm run bundle:linux
scripts.bundle:linux: node scripts/prepare-linux-packaging-tools.mjs && npm run prepare:linux && npm run bundle:linux:portable && npm run bundle:linux:rpm
scripts.bundle:linux:portable: node scripts/native-toolchain.mjs tauri bundle --bundles deb && node scripts/finalize-linux-deb.mjs && node scripts/finalize-linux-appimage.mjs
scripts.test: npm run test:frontend && npm run test:rust
scripts.check: tsc --noEmit && node scripts/native-toolchain.mjs cargo check --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml
scripts.lint: oxlint app components src lib scripts tests && node scripts/native-toolchain.mjs cargo clippy --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --all-targets -- -D warnings
scripts.format: oxfmt && node scripts/native-toolchain.mjs cargo fmt --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml
scripts.format:check: oxfmt --check && node scripts/native-toolchain.mjs cargo fmt --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml -- --check
